name: cms-v3
description: Habbo retro CMS v3 — React 19 + Hono (Node 22). Strangler pattern: gira in parallelo al vecchio CMS PHP su porte separate.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "yarn workspace @cms-v3/api dev" "yarn workspace @cms-v3/web dev"
